mapper.select: SELECT * FROM "user" WHERE UPPER(first_name) LIKE UPPER(CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')) OR UPPER(last_name) LIKE UPPER(CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%'))
SELECT id, username, password, first_name, last_name, dob, roles FROM "user"
mapper.insert: SELECT gen_random_uuid() INSERT INTO "user" (id, username, password, first_name, last_name, dob, roles) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{dob}, #{roles})
mapper.update: UPDATE "user" SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, dob = #{dob}, password = #{password}, roles = #{roles} WHERE id = #{id}
